expires_today.title: Disney Masters Collection and Originals by Fantagraphics
expires_today.description: Comics starring your favorite Disney legends!
expires_today.long_description: Iconic Disney characters take the world of comics by storm in this bundle of Disney Masters and original comic series from Fantagraphics! The greedy Scrooge McDuck journeys from the Yukon to Atlantis and beyond in Walt Disney’s Uncle Scrooge: The Diamond Jubilee Collection! Mickey Mouse goes steampunk in the retrofuturist odyssey Walt Disney’s Mickey Mouse Versus The Mouseton Society of Evil! Epic Mickey hops from your console to the pages of his own comics in the video game inspired Disney Epic Mickey: The Comics Collection! Join Mickey Mouse, Donald Duck, Uncle Scrooge, and more of your favorite Disney legends in new tales and classic adventures in this bundle for old fans and newcomers alike! Grab this collection now at the price of your choice, and support First Book charity with your purchase.

expires_today.title: Clip Studio Creativity Collection: Paint, Draw & Animate
expires_today.long_description:
Design characters, create worlds, and tell infinite stories with this bundle of Clip Studio art and animation software! This bundle includes a 12-month license to Clip Studio Paint Pro Version 5.0, 2D animation program Moho Debut 12.5, Ultimate 3D Models Pack, 3D Poses, and Brush Packs for Clip Studio Paint, and more! Paint your digital artwork, design your comic, and put your stories in motion with this library of art and animation programs! Get all of these and more at the price of your choosing, and support classrooms in need with DonorsChoose with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 22nd, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Ultimate Vegan Cookbook Bundle by Page Street Publishing
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Whether you’re committed to the plant-based lifestyle or thinking about giving it a try, there’s never been a better time to go vegan—especially with this bundle of over 60 vegan cookbooks! We’ve teamed up with Page Street Publishing for a treasure trove of recipes that bring the joys of veganism right to your home kitchen. If you’re looking for Southern soul food with a vegetarian twist, scrumptious Mexican food that keeps things verde, delicious Asian-inspired meals for herbivores, or just tips on how to save while keeping your meals cruelty-free, you’ll find all of that and so much more in this bundle! Grab these cooking ebooks at the price of your choice, and help support World Central Kitchen with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Rage Inducing Difficult Games
expires_tomorrow.description: Rage quitting is for the weak
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
If the game isn’t challenging, then does it even count? Pay what you want for the Rage Inducing Difficult Games Bundle, where every title is a battlefield! Test your skills in GRIME, the unforgiving action-adventure RPG centered around horror and intrigue. Take on Lorn’s Lure, the perilous platformer with novel climb-anything mechanics. Or turn up the platforming heat with Jump King, where one missed jump could ruin your run! Discover your limits and help support Prevent Cancer in the process.

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 19th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Dark Horse 40th Anniversary Bundle, Presented by IGN
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Celebrate the 40th Anniversary of Dark Horse with this bundle of the publisher’s most legendary comic series, brought to you by IGN! Enjoy fabulous omnibus editions of series starring the likes of Hellboy, the Witcher, and Vampire Hunter D! Enter a new era with the superhumans and villains of Dark Horse Heroes! Rediscover classic favorites like the epic fantasy saga Elfquest, new bestsellers like Vikings-meets-Succession drama Kill All Immortals, and totally unique genre mashups like Anthony Bourdain’s Hungry Ghosts! Collected together in this bundle are 40 of Dark Horse’s best series and omnibus editions, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support comic creator charity Hero Initiative with your purchase!

Founded in 1986, Dark Horse is one of the industry’s leading publishers of comics, graphic novels, books, manga, and collectibles. Known for championing creator-first storytelling, Dark Horse has published landmark titles including Hellboy, Sin City, The Umbrella Academy, and Black Hammer, as well as acclaimed licensed works based on Avatar: The Last Airbender, The Witcher, The Last of Us, and Critical Role. The company also helped define manga publishing in North America with classics such as Lone Wolf and Cub, Trigun, Berserk, and Blade of the Immortal.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Ultimate AI & Machine Learning Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Design the ultimate agentic sidekick, digital assistant, and beyond with the hottest AI bundle of the summer! This comprehensive course collection provides a practical journey from machine learning fundamentals to advanced agentic AI and generative AI development. You’ll master core ML concepts like regression, classification, cross-validation, decision trees, random forests, SVMs, neural networks, CNNs, and PCA through theory and hands-on labs. In a Humble Exclusive, members unlock access to Amazon Bedrock for building chatbots and more! Plus, your purchase helps support Coral Guardian!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before August 13th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Twin Sails Interactive 2026
expires_tomorrow.description: A new spin on the board games you love
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Love board games but don’t love keeping track of all those pesky pieces? We have the solution: all the games you love in digital form, to play on your console or PC! We’ve teamed up with Twin Sails Interactive for a massive digital bundle of board games and add-ons, from classic fantasy tales, sci-fi adventures, horror stories, and beyond. Scheme your way to the Iron Throne in A Game of Thrones: The Board Game! Enter the mysterious, eldritch world of H.P. Lovecraft in Arkham Horror: Mother’s Embrace! Gather resources and conquer the Red Planet in Terraforming Mars! Lead a band of mercenaries through the dangerous lands of Gloomhaven! There’s a lot more to explore in this bundle of fan-favorite digital board games and expansion packs, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support the gene therapy outreach of FOXG1 Research Foundation with your purchase!
